name: Qibla Route
summary: A single open route surrounds one gold square, gathering the identity around a shared destination.
why: A broad path turns around a single square destination. Its open corner creates an entry into the composition, while the square quietly refers to the Kaaba. The diagonal orientation gives the mark direction without adding an arrow.
risk: The open route may also suggest a wayfinding or location symbol. The Kaaba reference is abstract, so the app name supplies the prayer context.
sub2: A quiet reference to the Kaaba

palette.name: QIBLA ROUTE / MARINE + PALE STONE + GOLD

reasonToChoose: You want a bold sense of direction and a clear focal point.
